001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.types;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005
006import org.lwjgl.util.vector.Vector2f;
007
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.BaseSensorGhostCreator;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GhostFrequencies;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhost;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhostManager;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.velfield.SlipstreamTerrainPlugin2;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.velfield.SlipstreamTerrainPlugin2.SlipstreamSegment;
016
017public class RacerGhostCreator extends BaseSensorGhostCreator {
018        
019        
020        @Override
021        public List<SensorGhost> createGhost(SensorGhostManager manager) {
022                if (!Global.getSector().getCurrentLocation().isHyperspace()) return null;
023                CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
024                Vector2f loc = pf.getLocation();
025                
026                //LocationAPI hyper = Global.getSector().getHyperspace();
027                float radius = 1000f;
028                SlipstreamTerrainPlugin2 plugin = pickNearbySlipstream(radius, manager.getRandom());
029                if (plugin == null) return null;
030                
031                float [] coords = plugin.getLengthAndWidthFractionWithinStream(loc, 0f, false, radius);
032                if (coords == null) return null;
033                
034                SlipstreamSegment start = plugin.getSegmentForDist(coords[0]);
035                if (start == null) return null;
036                
037                List<SlipstreamSegment> segments = plugin.getSegments();
038                
039                List<SensorGhost> result = new ArrayList<SensorGhost>();
040                
041                int num = 1 + manager.getRandom().nextInt(5);
042                
043                float distBehind = 1000f;
044                float currDist = 0f;
045                for (int i = start.index - 1; i >= 0f && num > 0; i--) {
046                        SlipstreamSegment curr = segments.get(i);
047                        currDist += curr.lengthToNext;
048                        
049                        float b = plugin.getFaderBrightness(coords[0]);
050                        if (currDist > distBehind && b > 0) {
051                                num--;
052                                
053                                RacerGhost g = new RacerGhost(manager, curr, plugin);
054                                if (g.isCreationFailed()) continue;
055                                result.add(g);
056                                distBehind += 500f * manager.getRandom().nextFloat();
057                        }
058                }
059                return result;
060        }
061
062        
063        @Override
064        public float getFrequency(SensorGhostManager manager) {
065                return GhostFrequencies.getRacerFrequency(manager);
066                //return 10000f;
067        }
068        
069        public boolean canSpawnWhilePlayerInOrNearSlipstream() {
070                return true;
071        }
072}
